observedOfficialCapabilities: The live SD results app exposes current election CSV/media/export pages and ResultsAjax service methods, but those public pages currently default to the 2026 Primary Election, not the 2024 General Election.

The ResultsExport page exposes Statewide, Legislative, and county export controls as ASP.NET postback targets for the current election; the page source did not expose a stable static 2024 General export URL.
The WSDL exposes GetMapDataArchive, GetVoterTurnoutArchive, and GetProvisionalDataArchive methods that require an integer ElectionID.
A Wayback capture of the official results root from 2024-11-05 confirms the archived shell was the 2024 General Election and referenced the older SD results service root.

The older official SD results service identifies ElectionID 684 as the 2024 General Election candidate archive: GetCandidates returns Trump, Harris, Oliver, Kennedy, Dusty Johnson, and Sheryl Johnson federal markers.
GetMapDataArchive with ElectionID 684, Type=SWR, Category=CTY, and RaceID=0 returns county map-data rows for 2024 federal races, including President map RaceID 12665 and U.S. House map RaceID 11954.

GetVoterTurnoutArchive with ElectionID 684 returns 66 county turnout rows and is retained as a state-native turnout lead, but it is not active until denominator timing and replacement semantics are reviewed.

The official archive map-data totals do not reconcile to the current certified-style staging totals, so the official canvass PDF/static export or another reconciling official archive export remains the blocker.
officialSourceProbe.blocker: Use the identified official SD SOS archive ElectionID 684 as the concrete follow-up path, but obtain the official 2024 General Election Canvass and Certificate PDF/static export or another official archive/export payload that reconciles to certified county President and U.S. House totals before promoting SD to completed official-native coverage. The retained ElectionID 684 map-data totals are 428,728 President votes and 421,264 U.S. House votes, which are 194 and 184 votes below the current certified-style staging totals.

archiveProbe.method: Queried the archived official SD ResultsAjax service and retained candidate, statewide county map-data, and turnout archive evidence for 2024 General ElectionID 684.
archiveProbe.result: ElectionID 684 returned 2024 General Election federal candidate markers and county map-data rows. President map RaceID 12665 totals 428,728 votes across 264 candidate-county rows; U.S. House map RaceID 11954 totals 421,264 votes across 132 candidate-county rows; turnout returns 66 county rows. Because these map totals do not reconcile to current certified-style staging totals, SD remains in source discovery until an official certified canvass/export or reconciling official payload is retained.
